notes.title: Be Our Guest: Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Just put out a smaller update with a ton of fixes and some behind the scenes changes. Big part of this update won't effect those of you already playing goo, but is still a big update nonetheless! 

[h1]Play as guest:[/h1]
We have added a new way to start you goo Journey, with a 'Play as Guest' option now added. We heard from a lot of new users that they don't want to use their email on some random Indie game developer to play a Goo game, That is totally valid so now you Create a "Guest Account" that can do everything a main account does without using an email.(We only use your email currently to help you recover you account and to make it easier to do crossplay). After making a Guest account you can upgrade it and add an email and password at any point and save any progress you made on your guest account. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/08b57ade2319009fbe8a07a345c60099b13f41cf.png[/img]

We will not be able to help you recover any guest account that you lose access too! So Goo carefully.  

[h1]Fixes/ Working Goo[/h1]
Sometimes to coordinate things across all the devices that you can Goo on we have to take down the servers, before we just would bring the servers down and people would keep erroring out when trying to connect, we have added a nice friendly goo to help alert you if things are down!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/fd756bd6ea5638097974be90dde67c748067036b.png[/img]

On top of that we have fixed (hopefully for the last time) the Goopendium being busted for Omni Goos. As well as a few other fixes of things that were broken for the newest goos such as Franken Goo not showing up in the previews or Nighty being able to hold items if they were holding on to one before mutating.

[h1]What's next?!?[/h1]
As always thank you guys so much for all the support you give to us and Goo Gladiators. I keep hinting at a new game mode in a near update and am happy to say that I think next update will be the one!! Keep in eye out for it, We are aiming for May for a Royal GOOd time ;) Do let us know anything else you would like to see in Goo! Hope to see you in the arena soon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/a38d0752fd078a0774c0cb59f065d542dac22e4e.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Year New Goo: Content update.
notes.notes:
Its a new year with some new goo to celebrate! 

To celebrate the new year we have reworked a lot of the goos and added 10 new goos across all existing groups of goos (3 of them are in the base game) with some new mechanics. On top of that we upgraded and fixed a lot of other things in the game. Lets get into it!


[h1]New Goos![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/00cc6a680a6b18fca39f08720be447b46c49aefc.gif[/img]
We have added new Goos to all of the base Goo Groups.

To the base game we added Hippo, Novelty and Penguin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/f0eadffe6077edf173ed44485697750bcfee3066.gif[/img]

Penguin is another Ice goo joining Golem in the base pack who will fill the void of a late game tank that the base goo group is sorely lacking. 

If you find yourself endlessly cycling items, Hippo is the go to goo, Hippo will give you free item cycling for free each round with the number of hippos that you have!

Lastly the Novelty Goo
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/3c8376ed1774ff08670f5f05396c778598d6623d.gif[/img]
Novelty introduces a fresh new mechanic of position swapping! When hit Novelty will move to a different spot to try and avoid being hit again making them difficult to lock down. The addition of a clown nose has also been added to give other goos an ability to swap spots during battle to a limited capacity.


Each other group has at least one goo added to it, We won't go into them all here, but here is the full list:
[b]Egg goos[/b]: Crocy, The Shoe crocodile 
[b]Spooky Goos[/b]: Frank, the undying
[b]Chilly Goos[/b]: Toasty, the warm speedster
[b]Cryptid Goos[/b]: Nighty, he has no arms!
[b]Electrix Goos[/b]: Sssshock, the vibing viper
[b]Spring Goos[/b]: Bee & BayBee, Bzzzzing is better done together

All these goos will be added to their groups for free so if you already have unlocked their group you will start to see them around!

[h1]New background & Icons[/h1]
To celebrate the new goos we have added some new Icons and backgrounds! Themed around some of our new goos. A picnic for Bee and a Circus for Novelty Goo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/eb0e29e0d392950c0c326363905ee88fd356a057.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/5967f31772685cbb565f8d1337749cdc86f95566.png[/img]


[h1]Balance updates[/h1]
A ton of goos have been updated! Most notably we have reworked a lot of the Omni goos as they were dominating the arena. We gave some buffs to older goos as well to try and make them more competitive. Here's the full balance changes:
 
[h2] Goo changes [/h2]
[b]Jumptio[/b]: [Rework]
-Mutates from bubble goo getting a Bottled Lightning instead of Tadpole (this makes it a later game goo)
-gives +7 HP instead of +3 when hit.
- HP 8 -> 20
- ATK 5 -> 15

[b]Meow[/b]
- ATK 7 -> 9

[b]Meooooow[/b]
- ATK 16 -> 18
- HP 8 -> 9

[b]ClayVase[/b]: [Nerf]
-ATK/HP: 10 -> 8
-Takes an extra turn to turn into Vase

[b] Vase [/b] [Nerf]
-Ability now does 25% damage to enemies on death instead of 100%

[b]Projector[/b]: [Rework]
- ATK 10 -> 12
- HP 5 -> 10
- Def 5 -> 0 
- Ability Now gives +2/+2 Atk/HP to goo in front and behind instead of +5/+5

[b]Pixel[/b]: [Nerf]
- ATK 20 -> 18

[b]Rover[/b]: [Nerf]
-Ability now gives +2 HP instead of +5.

[b]Peas[/b]: [Buff]
-Ability now triggers every other Attack for x2 damage instead of every 3rd for x3

[b]Mika Worm[/b]: [Nerf]
-Ability now gives +1 DEF to space goos instead of +2

[b]Ice Cream[/b]: [Nerf] 
-Ability now gives +8 HP instead of +10 HP

[h2] Item Changes [/h2]
[b]Bottled Lightning[/b]:
-Now part of the base goo items
-Now gives +1 HP, +1 ATK -1 Speed (the added HP is new)

[b]Honey[/b]
-New item, replaces Heart if using Spring goos, Same stats as Heart but can mutate into Bee

[b]Clown Nose[/b]
-New Item, one time use per round! Will swap spots with the goo behind you when hit.


[h1]The ending bits[/h1]
As always thank you guys so much for your continued support of Goo Gladiators, Your support and seeing all the teams you guys make is what keeps us going <3 Please let us know anything else you would like to see either here on the steam forums or in our [url=https://discord.gg/K7Req6Qgm8]Discord[/url]! I'll see you soon with more Goo Goodness :)

notes.title: Content Update: New Goos, New Items, New ways to play!
notes.notes:
Hey! Long time no see. We have been in the lab cooking up the largest update ever for Goo Gladiators. Over 20 new goos new items and some nice 'quality of life' improvements. Lets get into it!


[u][h1]Omni Goos[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/0aeadce0aa54af5cee99d8200413e0fe11ba7ccc.gif[/img]

We have added a new group of Goos! These new Goos have come to mix up the arena. They work differently than the base game goos as instead of mutating multiple times (Base goo -> Golem -> Moss For example.) The goos you can get will vary depending on the base goo you use! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/c504be9195d52632de46ffffeedbcdcb735db07f.png[/img]

You start with two base Omni Goos, your next two base goos you get have an Extra eye untill you get to the third that has three eyes and physic powers! Each Omni goo will mutate differently depending on what goo they are. Omni with one eye given a paint pallet will turn into something different than one with three eyes for example! With this all goos in the Omni goo group are all one of four new Types of goos, Omni, Space, Art or Food. Food goos are not meant for eating, but for battle in the gladiatorial arena. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/b76c3799ab730e0318c4903bade7479b5d3a6d5d.gif[/img]

[u][h1]Arena Run Changes[/h1][/u]
[b]Starting a new Run has been changed! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/1d0c649fd4ba47f1fbd94789332ad67bae273e31.png[/img]

You now can pick your Goos you want to do a run with with at the start of each run. This will make it easier to swap between strategies quickly without having to go to the storeroom in the lab to change them out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/4bccbb69b6fe206449f2d9a55da899449d30c815.gif[/img]

As well have changed how Private Matches work. Previously each player would pick their own Goos to play with. Now we have changed it to where the Host will pick the goos that the whole match will play with! This will let anyone in the match use the Host's Goos even if they haven't unlocked them.


[u][h1]Other new things[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/edff4b79cb210700ce28bbbd6b66a2e3898b3760.png[/img]

We have added a ton more new small improvements and new things throughout the game. Three new background. The surface of a planet (for the new space goos) A kitchen (for the new food goos) and lastly an art museum for the art goos! (Featuring some familiar faces) 

On top of that we have added some new Icons headlined by the lovely Cocoa Puff. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/a01603c40f3756086e26536305d14baecc092b9b.png[/img]

Lastly we have gone through and made a lot of the interface of the game scale a lot nicer on larger screens. So you no longer have to squint to see goos on your extra large monitor! 

[u][h1]Final Thoughts and what is next!?[/h1][/u]
As always thank you all so much for enjoying Goo Gladiators watching all the cool teams that you guys have sent into the arena is one of our favorite things to do. If you have something new would you like to see in the game please don't hesitate to let us know here on the Steam Forums or on our Discord. For the rest of the year we want to have at least one more big update that would include a new game mode and some more new Goos for [b]ALL[/b] of the existing goo groups. Also do expect a few small update once we figure out some more of the balance with the new Goos!

[u][h2]Full(ish) Patch Notes[/h2][/u]
[h3]1.15.0[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added new Goo Group: Omni Goos: 24 new goos, New Base Goo(s), New Items!
[*]Added a screen when starting your run to pick what goos you want to play with
[*]Added 3 new backgrounds
[*]Added tons of new Icons
[*]Added new battle soundtrack and new menu soundtrack.
[*]Added Toggle to choose to play with just your base goo or with both base goos (Omni & Default)
[*]Changed lab background and main menu background to celebrate the Omni Goos
[*]Changed: In private matches the Host will now pick the same set of goos the whole lobby will play with (this will unlock all goos that the host has for everyone for that match)
[*]Changed: Goos picked at the start of the run will stay through the run. This fixes an exploit where you could change them by 'exiting' and re-entering a run and swapping goos
[*]Changed: Tons of UI scaling to better fit on larger screens.
[*]Changed: Goopendium to lock into you selected goos/items properly to account for new Omni/Default goos tree.
[*]Fixed: Bug where unlocking achievements would sometimes not save properly
[*]Fixed: Bug that made quests not save near the end of the day work properly
[*]Fixed: some visual bugs where 'KO'd" goos would not show the proper animation
[*]Fixed: bug where some of the goopendium alignments were off.
[/list]

notes.title: March balance and content update!
notes.notes:
Another goo update just went out. This update has tons of balance changes and bug fixes and even a few cool new features. Lets get right into it.

[h1] Balance changes [/h1]
The area has been reset as many goos have been buffed or reworked. Firstly heres some nerdy stats brought to you by nerdy birdy [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/33a3e015b72ccfd2fc8b58f6cb7695eb29ec82b5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/33a3e015b72ccfd2fc8b58f6cb7695eb29ec82b5.gif[/img][/url]

All Goos last Arena (expect intermediate goos like seed, tadpole & burning) Got some wins in the arena!
Here are the one who had the most luck:

[h3][u]Top 6:[/u][/h3]
(1) Flirx
(2) Meow
(3) Snaim
(4) Swampy
(5 -T) Nerdy Birdy
(5 -T) Frumptun

With all the recent buffs to fire goos in recent updates it seems to have paid off for the Flirx as it had the most luck in the arena with the highest win rate of all goos!

Most of the rest of the goos were pretty close in the middle of the pack, however there were some goos who fizzled out at the bottom!

[h3][u]Bottom 6:[/u][/h3]
(0) Cha-boom
(1) Chomper
(2) Yolki
(3) Mooshy
(4) Bubble
(5) Jack
(6) Kite

Cha-boom even with its recent re-works only won in the arena ONCE since the last balance update (with around 15k matches happening since then, that's not a good look) We decided to give these goos a little bit of love in this update.

Bubble and Mooshy are both goos that come into play in the mid - late game. They used to be painfully slow at 3 speed so upping their speed to 4 and giving them a bit more attack and health should help them be able to catchup with some of the other goos at that stage of the game! As well Mooshy's Mushroom summons will be a little faster and have a little more attack!

Kite, Chomper, Yolki and Jacks all had buffs to their abilities buffed as their stats are not bad. Kite now will also give +5 ATK to Flying goos as well as Electrik goos after being hit. Jacks as well now gives 13 HP to fresh summons instead of the 10 it did before! (This will also help Mooshy be more viable when they are combined) Lastly Chomper and Yolki's abilities got better giving slightly more HP for both of their abilities.

And for the big bomb in the room, Cha-boom got a major buff and now starts with 40 HP (up from 30) , 20 ATK (up from 16) and also now starts with 1 Defense! So it will now have an easier time staying alive long enough to go off in later rounds! 

[h1] Ease of Use updates! [/h1]
We added a ton of community suggested 'ease of use' improvements to the game this update! You can now see the type and starting stats of goos in the Goopendium, as well we now have a special section in the item list for Items got from goos (bubble, sap, ect)

As well we have made it easier to join friend's private matches! Adding a 'join game' button below them if you have them on your friends list. 

Ever been in a match and forgetting how many wins or losses you have at that point? Worry no more! as we now show your current run stats on the battle menu as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/0b442147d5bf1f00bef4ebc24a0591e29cf137d8.png[/img]

Lastly we have added a Global replays to the replays menu! It will show the most recent Arena wins and the Teams they have won with, Go here to gloat or try to get some ideas from Teams that are winning in the arena!

[h1] Final Thoughts and new update [/h1]
The next update is going to be the biggest update in the history of the game! We will have over 20 new goos, 4 new goo types a new game mode and TONS of new content :) Thank you guys so much for the support that you have shown Goo Gladiators the past Year and a half the love and support you have shown these creatures means the world to me <3 I'll leave you with a sneak peek at someone who you will be seeing a lot of soon...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/c504be9195d52632de46ffffeedbcdcb735db07f.png[/img]

notes.title: Content update: Electrik Goos & more!
notes.notes:
New update! New goos, New background, some reworks and more! Lets get into it.


[h1]New Background.[/h1]
We have only had two backgrounds since launch as such we added a new one (we will try to have a new one each update as well to add even more variety) This can be unlocked by anyone in the background area on the main menu! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/4be2db1100d2fc1ed4b441b1813a94eb433a97a6.png[/img]
 
[h1]Rework of 'reflect' attacks[/h1]
Fire goos have really never risen to be relevant in the games Meta like I would have liked them too. As such they are getting a slight buff. The reflect abilities on Burning, Flirx, and Shoe goos would only ever drop a goo to 1 HP. It now can KO them! This should make them more dangerous as you can now take out enemies without even needing to attack them!

[h1]New Goos![/h1]
5 new goos to discover and play with! The Electrik Goos. Electrik goos center around doing effects to other goos when they are toched. That is pretty shocking if you ask me. All Electrik goos have a new type they target of 'fastest goo'. This can make for some interesting counters to fast teams.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/da29f4c5d662eec5aa45bd305bc328ec0aedcd63.png[/img]

Lets go over the new goos briefly and talk about their abilities...

[b][u]Shocks:[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/b98342004c6967555492582b24df9f3643ec8ad0.gif[/img]

The Base for all Electricity is a little spark. That is where Shocks comes in. They are a Round 1 Goo that will mutate into any of the 4 other Electrik Goos. Shocks by themselves can pack a punch too reflecting two damage on any goo that touches them.

[b][u]Kite:[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/caaf734ee329def01daa3ef7951d3db21ffc1980.gif[/img]

The Kite goo is a mid game goo meant for heavy Eletrik Goo teams. Whem hit it will give any other friendly Electrik goos 5 ATK!! Wowza

[u][b]Eel:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/106ebbf1b3d648baff5464b8cea35973b2372ff7.gif[/img]

Eel brings in another new mechanic of doing an action at the start of a battle! Eel will shock the entire enemy team for 2 points of damage at the start of the battle! This will help knock out anyone who is neglecting beefing up shields in the late game!

[u][b]Robby:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/d2054c088a6d7a2ecf8725dc3749ccc20a6be7df.gif[/img]

If you leave shock goo to grow on its own it will turn into Robby! Robby has a secret Weapon, Whenever Robby's Shields break it will deal 200% whatever Robby's Attack is onto whoever hit them! This can insta KOa goo without shields fairly easily!

[u][b]Hedgehog:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/dfbf5c1c6e8d722ed964fbe8d37bd8a6e65f20ae.gif[/img]

Lastly we have the Hedgehog! This is a great late game goo to help slow down the opponent.  Hedgehog will set the speed of any goo that hits it to 3!! This can really slow down the enemy team so you can go lighting fast past them! 

[h1]Final thoughts[/h1]
Thank you guys so much for still having fun with Goo! We are still working on a mobile version that will be cross-play and cross-progression with the Steam version that *should* be out fairly soon. As always please let us know if there's anything you would like to see in future updates! As well stay tuned for some some spooky themed holiday events coming next month.

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new background
[*] Added 5 new goos 3 new items
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes goos would show negative HP and still be on screen
[*] Fixed bug where feather was absent from item list.
[*] Fixed some bugs with the goo selection menu
[/list]
[h2]Reworks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bottled Lighting moved from round 5 item to a round 1 item
[*] Bottled Lighting is now -1 speed and +1 ATK  
[*] Jumpitio Rework:
ATK: 14 -> 5
Speed: 5 -> 6
Heath: 15 -> 8 
(you can now get it 3 turns earlier)
[*] Reflect abilities can now KO enemy goos! This is a buff for Burning, Flrix and Shoe goos! 
[/list]

notes.title: Spring Goos Content update!
notes.notes:
Spring has sprung. With this we have 5 new goos and a ton of game improvements. 

[h1]Performance improvements[/h1]
Lets get the less exciting stuff out of the way first. As any current or old player would know the game takes a long time to even show up on your computer! Some people had to wait for over a minute before they saw anything show up. That is now been brought down to just a few seconds! On top of that the game now uses less than half of the memory it used before while running the game AND is half size it was before (its now less than 400mb from 1GB). Long story short the game runs a whole lot better now.

[h1]New goos![/h1]
Now for the fun stuff. We have 5 new goos joining the gang! (spring goos will go into free rotation this Saturday (7/1) so everyone will get to check them out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/819ef9b22a094c4fe6ef4f0bbb9cd4447d6cb1cf.png[/img]

Lets talk about about our new friends!

[h2]BOohuk[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/c5c28d09374548dfd8b3e7217743ec4f53a8f67d.gif[/img]
BOohuk brings some new mechanics to the table! Whenever any goo mutates he will gain +2 HP/ATK
You can get him turn one with the new banana Item so you can start scaling BOohuk right away! He is mutated by the new held item Banana, When holding a banana any goo can benefit from gaining stats when mutating! This can stack with BOohuk's ability to really get things growing quick.

[h2]Acorn[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/3f8d3d99165c8267f9f44f9e40ce4d3a87bd16ba.gif[/img]
A big focus with this update was to give Plant goos some more options to be on par with Water goo teams. Acorn can help plants with a buff of +1 Defense to all other plant goos! Acorn is very selfless though and only can provide protection to his friends and not himself.

[h2]Buggo[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/beb83da900341065e442e4f34c2412f5ae12b3c7.gif[/img]
Buggo is the only Goo that you can't get from the base goo until Round 9! That is for good reason as they are a TANK, They gain +1 Defense after EACH attack. This can make them super annoying to kill if you don't have fast goos as they will keep protecting themselves!

[h2]Turnip[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/4651e89027bbc4910066959256dceb0c9a01e858.gif[/img]
Keeping with the trend of empowering plants, We didn't have something to compete with Gramma on the plant side so we have added Turnip! Turnip like Gramma will gain +1 HP/ATK PER plant goo that is also on the team. Combo-ed with Acorn and you can get some strong plants pretty quickly!

[h2]Chomper[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/502d5d7d054e4d10ae6fb5988b168f3065573728.gif[/img]
Lastly we have Chomper. They are an aggressive early game Plant goo. They will gain +5 HP whenever they are able to KO another Goo. This can really help your plants win some early game battles especially if they are getting buffs from the other new plant goos!


[h1]Other thoughts and future updates[/h1]
Sorry for the long time between this update and the last update!! We originally planned for this to come out last month, however my harddrive with a ton of the content for this update died and I hadn't backed it up in awhile so we had to re-do a ton of the work. I have better backup practices now so this will be avoided in the future. As such we are inching closer to the mobile release of Goo Gladiators and plan to add a new Type of goo very soon, You might be SHOCKED to see them so soon..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/dfbf5c1c6e8d722ed964fbe8d37bd8a6e65f20ae.gif[/img]



[h1]Full(ish) Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 5 new goos and 3 new items
[*]Improved startup time of game to around 3 seconds from over a minutue
[*]Reduced size of game download from over 1GB to ~400MB
[*]Improved performance of game on lower end machines
[/list]

notes.title: Discovering the impossible: Cryptid Content Update!
notes.notes:
A new goo update is here!!! Tons of new stuff, 10 New goos in the new Cryptid DLC, Improved goopendium, new Icons, a lifetime goo pass, 8 new Icons, and a new DLC in free rotation! 

[h1] New Cryptid Goos [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/895f752d63479401ecd20f67110df6542a723137.png[/img]

We have added a new goo DLC! The cryptid goos! The cryptid goos have a new unique way to mutate and unlock. There is a new goo for each type of goo! Using the new item of the 'Magnifier' You will get the cryptid of the corresponding type. 

So for example using it on a plant goo would give you the Swamp Monster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/660814b631c7be69f3ffa00f7a2c913f7a42c008.gif[/img]

Or using it on an Ice goo would give you a Baby Yeti.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/a80f8c90604b02c7f0930b4538933cab71bcaa91.gif[/img]

Lots of fun new mechanics have been added with each of these goos having unique abilities that will allow for some really fun new strategies. I'm super excited to see what teams you guys come up with :) 


[h1] Improved Goopendium [/h1]
Many of you have been asking for improvements to the Goopendium, Ask and you shall rececive!

The Goopendium on the main menu will now show you all Goos (even ones in DLCS not active or owned) To get a better idea of all the goos that are in the game! As well you can now hover over each of the goos to see what their ability is and who they attack! This will allow you to plan out a goo mutation plan with more information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/212a7d43399b4d5e989b5f58606ba2f54f0b6384.png[/img]

As well we have now added an 'Items tab' to the goopenidum! This will show you all the items in the game and what round they will appear on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/3a045679900abed7250e65e497921dd74180be86.png[/img]


[h1] Goo Lifetime pass and other things [/h1]
As we are getting to a lot of DLC goos with the Cryptid DLC being our 4th pack, we wanted to make it easier for the 'hardcore' goo players to not have to keep worrying about getting the new DLCS. Getting the lifetime pass will get you all current and future DLCS (We want to have a ton more) 

Here is a sneak peek at one of the goos in the Next update once spring has fully sprung :) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/2b806b6945e7f19430762c577dc3092fac2dd74b.gif[/img]

In the meantime we will start shifting the 'free rotation' DLC monthly. This month we will start with the Eggcellent DLC and then rotate through each of the DLCS from there. So May will be the Spooky DLC -> June will be the Chilly DLC and July will be the Cryptid DLC and so on :) As well you can now turn off the the Free DLC if you with to just play with the base goo pack.

We have also added 8 new Icons!!! Each DLC now has its own icon attached to it as well we have added a few other new icons to unlock and show some flair 

[h1] Finial Thoughts [/h1]
We have been hard at work on this update, and a ton of feature that didn't make it into this update yet. On top of that we still are working on a mobile version that should be coming very soon. Thank you guys for your continued support. Lots more fun Goo things planned for this year :) Let us know anything you would like to see in the game or any feedback for us in general. We would love to hear it.


[h1] Balance Updates [/h1]
Minimal balance updates this update! Lots of the goos feel around where we wanted them, except for some of the Winter goos. They were a little too strong..

[h3]Goos[/h3]
Golem: Type changed from Goo type to Ice type
Floaty: ATK 19 -> 15
Ice Golo: Speed 3 -> 2
Chiloki: ATK 2 -> 3
Chiloki: Speed 5 -> 4
Chiloki: HP 6 -> 4

[h3]Items[/h3]
Scarf: +1 HP per Ice/animal goo instead of +2 HP

[h1] Full(ish) Patch notes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new Cryptid DLC pack with 10 new goos and 3 new items
[*] Added Lifetime Goo Pass
[*] Added 8 new Icons
[*] Added Items menu to goopenidum
[*] Changed goopendium to show all goos in menu
[*] Changed goopendium to show abilities/attacks
[*] Changed a lot of item names to be cleaner to look at
[*] Changed so you can see the DLC goos and they arn't greyed out.

notes.title: Winter Update! New Goos. Free DLC rotation & More.
notes.notes:
The Winter update is here!!! 5 new goos have been added. 3 new items, New goo skins have been added. We have added a new 'free dlc pack' rotation, And of course we have some balance updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/724ee61d4921969ab46fc6864f55012c50f20604.gif[/img]

[h1] Free DLC pack rotation [/h1] 
Starting with this update we will start changing what goos are available to all players every couple of months by rotating between our three current DLC goo packs! We are starting of course with the winter pack so everyone can try out the new Ice type goos!

[h1] Winter goos [/h1]
5 new goos have been added this update. All of them also have a new 'goo type' of ICE. Let's go over each of them briefly.


[h2] Chiloki [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/13ea653b5d664f2215fbb8f7b082200f5429c171.gif[/img]

This early game goo likes to steal some extra things from the lab. Chiloki can be gotten by giving a scarf to a basic goo. They have pretty low starting stats, however they give you an extra item to pick from in your lab! This allows you to get items to get the right team earlier and easier!

[h2] Snofle [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/73d139a025b66eea6f52a370fcf5e1be77d44f60.gif[/img]

Snofle is a snowflake goo who likes to keep it cold. Snofle is another early game goo that will give friendly ice type goos +3 hp PER ROUND!!! There is a lot of potential for some big health Ice teams early on. Snofle will grow up into a bigger goo after 4 rounds...

[h2] Floaty [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/c04d7063901203343b9f3adfe62a6d45aeb9d2ec.gif[/img]

Like their previous form Floaty likes helping out other Ice goos. Floaty will protect ice goos from dying once! (like golem does currently to itself). They throw snowballs at other goos with their floating powers.

[h2] Ice Golo [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/b0072a727f9dc0e86c49b448c3405c4a0acdd200.gif[/img]

A chilly version of the golem. Like their golem counterparts they are slow and tanky. However as they are made of solid ice they will slow down all enemy goos when ice golo faints!

[h2] Sheal [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/95a9402fccf8a0e1108d3548646ca32de5207b6e.gif[/img]

Lastly we have the latest game goo we have ever added! Sticking with the theme of slow and tanky that  the Ice goos have Sheal has a large shield that they carry around and will use to protect their friends when they faint. They will give all friendly goos +5 defense before fainting!


[h1] Login bonus of Snowhat goo skin [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/e4c07cfc1f4ab971f5e54512d594c9f0af6149c7.png[/img]

Everyone who logs in in January/February will get an exclusive goo skin! Goo gotta stay warm with all these new ice goos running around.  

[h1] Balance Changed [/h1]
As always we have adjusted a few of the goos to be more balanced and fit better with the ever evolving meta! All balance changes are based off of win rates of certain teams as well as hearing your feedback on frustrating and underperforming goos!

[list] 
[*] Candace HP 5=> 10
[*] Stirkal HP 6=> 8
[*] Lems now gives +3 Atk istead of +2
[*] Brumpor now gives +3 HP instead of +2
[*] Brumpor HP 10 => 13
[*] Meooow HP 5 => 8
[/list]

[h1] Final thoughts [/h1]
As always thank you guys so much for letting me live my dream of making cool games for you guys. 2023 is going to be a GOOd year, We have tons of more goo content planned for you guys so stay tuned! Feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/f2SFSPDGft]join our Discord[/url] to interact with other goo lovers and find out about upcoming updates earlier.

[h1] Patch notes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Winter DLC
[*] Added 5 new Goos
[*] Added new goo type: Ice
[*] Added 3 new Items
[*] Added 2 new goo skins
[*] Changed game to 'auto login' if you have previously logged in
[*] Improved server response times while fighting in the arena 
[*] Fixed typo of Rank on wise award
[/list]

notes.title: Spooky Season Update!! 1.8 New Goos, Private Matches, Goopendium & More
notes.notes:
Hey guys! The first major update for Goo Gladiators is here and we have a TON of new content. I'll try to keep it short, but its a lot of stuff so feel free to skip around, anyways lets get into it.

[h1] Private Matches [/h1]
Ever wanted to play against your friends in real time?? Now you can!! Private matches are here, with its first game mode: 'Last Goo Standing.' In this mode you go through a normal 'arena' build facing off against other teams in your match. As the name implies its a free for all with each player getting 5 losses before they are eliminated! This is a super new feature so please let me know if you have any weird issues with it or any feedback on how to make it even better. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/eac35753c256065e6db3cb7ac87a2882d7652739.png[/img]

[h1] Goopendium [/h1]
BY FAR our most highly requested feature was to have some sort of in game guide for how to mutate the goos. Well now we have one, The Goopendium. Once you discover a goo it will appear here, You can view the Goopendium from the main menu or while in the goo labs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/2a4365f9361723ba31973b6e0a6444da17fc19a9.png[/img]

[h1] New Spooky Goos! [/h1]
We have a new spooky group of Goos to add to your team! Some spooky Halloween Goos!! As well as some new Goo Skins.

[h2] GoOoOo [/h2]
GoOoOo has a unique mechanic where it can be mutated from ANY goo. If you poison any goo it will be sent to the afterlife in the form of GoOoOo. It will maintain any stats it kept in its old form and gain some new abilities... First, it only takes 1/2 damage on all things hitting it, however as the goo is a spirit it can no longer hold or use items! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/5c757003ce45d01fd5a4fe818cb0c9c7698960e3.gif[/img]

[h2] Candance [/h2]
Candance is ready to collect some candy! She gets HP whenever a friendly goo faints. The HP will be equal to the 1/2 ATK of any goo that faints. She can get pretty beefy if she is positioned smartly! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/430a9f35177ca9a70cbd4bed125a36e5e75b2299.gif[/img]

[h2] Stirkal [/h2]
Stirkal is another Fire goo. Fire goos are all about Damage, as such Stirkal has a way to get a lot of ATK. Each time Stirkal attacks he increases his attack by 33%. (So if it had 9 ATK and hits something it will get +3 ATK after its first attack). If you manage to keep him alive he can get some pretty high attack values! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/391eb0f16a1ce13dc62dfd0655be903323845081.gif[/img]

[h2] New Skins [/h2]
We have also added some new goo skins. The witch hat is automatically unlocked if you get the spooky goos! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/12d2e188228c152f205ece2227a7ed28916d0f80.png[/img]

[h1] Gang Leaderboards [/h1]
Want to be the best gang??? Now you can see what gangs have the most wins. Here are the current rankings at the time of this update coming out. Stay tuned for more gang features in the coming months!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/a11a4281fb8cc359637006ccefc359bc25834d26.png[/img]

[h1] Balance Changes [/h1]
As this is the first balance update we have done since public release some things to note.
#1: Our balance philosophy is buff weaker goos before nerfing stronger goos.
#2: The leaderboards do not reset.
#3: All goo Teams will reset (only goo teams made after this update will still be active).

If you just want to see the raw balance updates feel free to skip to the bottom of this post. Below I'll go into some of the bigger changes and the justifications behind them.

A big balance that affects a lot of goos is the changed 'hit by' mechanic. Any goos or items that would trigger 'when hit' now trigger when hit by more than just an attack (Ex: Shoe Goo's reflect).

Bubble and Cha-Boom by far have the lowest win rates of any goos. To fix this they both are getting reworks to make them more interesting to use and win with! Bubble still will hit enemies for 1/2 of ATK however instead of popping its ATK and HP will just be halved each time it attacks! That way you can get multiple attacks in with them. As well Cha-Boom won some more matches than Bubble it still was hard to win with. Cha-Boom now doesn't damage any other Fire goos and got a 33% increase in starting health to tank more hits before exploding. 

Speaking of Fire goos, Fire goos are viable but still less effective than plants and water goos that scaled late game. As such Burning Goo and Flrix now reflect more damage onto their attacker. (25%-> 33%  And  50% -> 75%) This paired with the damage changes and the Cha-Boom rework should make for some interesting team compositions! 

Only one goo got a sizable nerf this update (see note #1) That is the Freddo the dragon. Freddo was very hard to beat once he started to knock out goos and get bigger. Freddo now gets +10 HP & ATK when knocking out an enemy instead of +15 HP/ATK/Defense. This should make his scaling less crazy.

We have reworked a ton of the held items to make them all have certain roles in certain builds. The Crown and Top Hat were by far the most used items. Crown now only gives +1/+1 on a win instead of +2/+2 and for an item that you could attach on round 2 it was a must have item at a +2/+2. As well sword/fedora/sunhat all give an extra +1 to each stat they modify! 

[h1] Final Thoughts [/h1]
Thank you guys so much for all the love and playtime that you have given Goo Gladiators. It has been super fulfilling to see everyone enjoying it and hearing what everyone thinks about it, It has been a great time making this game. Do feel free to leave us a review on Steam (they help us a ton), come join the fun [url=https://discord.gg/f2SFSPDGft]on our Discord[/url] and if you're feeling super generous support us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/SfsStudios]Patreon[/url] to help us keep awesome content coming to the game for a long time coming.  

[h1] Full(ish) Patch notes [/h1]
[b]1.8.0[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Gang Leaderboard
[*] Added new goo skins, no face, Colorless
[*] Added new spooky goo DLC (Three new goos, a goo skin and some new items)
[*] Added showing of goos extra stats when in the arena view on hover
[*] Added display showing when something is going it mutate in x amount of turns
[*] Added private matches
[*] Added Goopendium
[*] Changed 'when hit' to now trigger when hit by anything
[*] Changed the placeholder text of 'cool team' on the replay menu to show the round #
[*] Improved server performance when applying an item 
[*] Fixed bug where sleeping powder had a 2x drop rate
[*] Fixed Freddie no longer is double buffed when KOing a rock goo.
[*] Fixed string item sometime not triggering when attached
[*] Fixed wording for award saying level instead of rank.
[*] Fixed bug where hurt animation would show improperly when bubble popped
[*] Fixed pudbun not actually getting its attack when hurt
[*] Fixed bug where your run would be canceled if you updated your icon background or skin
[/list]
[b]1.8.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed mutate counter being wrong on some of the goos
[*] Fixed private matches not exiting to the group play menu when complete. 
[/list]

[h1] Full Balance updates [/h1]
[list]
[b] Ability Changes [/b]
[*] Tadpole: Ability now reduces ATK by -2 instead of -1.
[*] Burning Goo: Ability now reflects 33% of its ATK value on attacker instead of 25%
[*] Flrix: Ability now reflects 75% of its ATK value on attacker instead of 50%
[*] Cha-Boom: Its attacks will now not hurt Other fire goos
[*] Freddo: Ability now gives +10/+10 HP/ATK instead of +15/+15/+15 HP/ATK/DEF

[b] Stat Changes (This is their starting stats) [/b]
[*] Rock: Speed: 2 -> 3

[*] Bubble: ATK: 6-> 14
[*] Bubble: HP: 15 -> 16

[*] Moss: Speed: 3 -> 4

[*] Mushies: ATK: 2 -> 4
[*] Mushies: Speed: 1 -> 2

[*] Flowa: Speed: 5 -> 4
[*] Flowa: HP: 8 ->6 

[*] Jumptio: HP: 10 -> 15 

[*] Freddo: ATK: 20 -> 25
[*] Freddo: HP: 20 -> 25
[*] Freddo: DEF: 20 -> 0

[*] Cha-Boom: HP: 20 -> 30 

[b] Item changes [/b]
[*] Crown: +2/+2 HP/ATK -> +1/+1 HP/ATK (per win)
[*] Fedora: +1 DEF -> +2 DEF
[*] Sunhat: +2 HP -> +3 HP
[*] Sword: +2 ATK -> +3 ATK
[*] Fish: now also gives +1 HP on a loss
[*] Top Hat: No longer gives Defense
[/list]

notes.title: Ease of use and bug fixes update! 1.7.3
notes.notes:
Hey guys! We just pushed out a smaller update fixing some of the issues people have been having since launch and make things a little easier.

[h1] Sign-in Fixes [/h1]
The most commonly encountered bug/ complaint was on signup not being able to paste in things! So we fixed that as well as added a button to add the @ symbol as some keyboards were not detecting people hitting the @ symbol on them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/623389eecac2d33c1abbb0bcc177621f649a3cf3.png[/img]


[h1]Ease of Use Improvements [/h1]
A lot of newer users were having trouble understanding how mutated vs held items were handled. So we have added some more text prompts when applying items to help make it more clear what is going on. As well as not allowing people to do silly things like giving a fish to a goo already holding a fish. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/3c05c6654da411e733d120004e9d98cea4d73448.png[/img]


[h1] Final thoughts/ future things [/h1]
Overall thank you guys so making the launch great so far! Over 500 people have tried out the game since it came out Thursday. We have a lot more planned for the game such as new Goos, new game modes and even more free content. Feel free to leave us a Steam review, those help us out a ton and let me know if you have any feedback or questions! See you soon.

[list]
[*] Added Copy/Paste functionality to the login/create screens
[*] Added @ symbol button on account creation for certain keyboards
[*] Added preview display for Eggcellent goos DLC to see sneak preview what they are.
[*] Added Text prompts when replacing a held item

notes.title: Update 1.7! New Goos! New Items! New balance! More Fixes.
notes.notes:
Big update to prepare us for launch! There are new goos, new items and tons of Quality improvements.

[h1] NEW GOO! [/h1]
The first of the unlockable Goo packs is out! It contains a ton of new Items and 10 new Goos. Some of my favorite goos are in this pack all with cool new strategies and ways to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/d7da00e30bbef2fc337bdea087b38ab389b70492.gif[/img]

[h1] Balance changes [/h1]
The two most under utilized goos where by far the bubble goo and the Frob. As such both are getting pretty big buffs. The bubble goo now will only hit enemies instead of everyone. As well the bubble goo used to be quite difficult to get as you had to lose a bunch of matches to unlock them. Now you get them by using the 'bubble' item that is gotten through having 3 or more water goos on your team. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/b8cd7dc431eb7a741479f29d6496090b054c2d03.gif[/img]

The Frob did not have nearly enough HP to be the tank it was intended to be. As such its starting HP has DOUBLED as well as doubling its starting defense. This should make the frob more of an attractive option in the mid game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/c2adfa4bfefe32ba140db0acd3a986632afe5e8c.gif[/img]

[h1] Final thoughts [/h1]
I'm super excited to see more people play the game and see what cool teams and strategies develop! As always feel free to let me know if you have any feedback or questions, See you in the arena!! 

[h1] full(ish) Patch notes [/h1]
[h1] 1.7.0[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Eggecellent DLC goo pack (10 new goos!)
[*] Added new Attack Type 'Lowest HP' both Meows, Chicky and dragon all now target this. 
[*] Added New item to base game: Bubble, It appears if you have 3 or more water goos. Mutates into bubble -2atk +5HP 
[*] Added New item to base game: Crown, turn 2 Item. Gives +2 HP, +2 Atk per Victory
[*] Added new icon: the EYEcon
[*] Added two new awards: Scientist and Stylish.
[*] Added support for new reses: 1920x1080, 1600x900, 1366x768
[*] Changed you can now exit replays by hitting back or escape
[*] Changed nerdy birdy now talks to you during the tutorial
[*] Changed. Hitting tab will now move you through signin/signup prompts
[*] Fixed bug where devil and Brumpor ability wouldn't always trigger
[*] Fixed bug where you could unlock the strong achievement without actually doing it.
[*] Fixed bug where awards could overflow when unlocked
[*] Fixed bug where some users could get a longer username than allowed via steam linking
[*] Fixed bug where gang search could overflow.
[*] Fixed some other performance things under the hood ;) 

[h1] Balance things [/h1]
[*] Bubble goo now only hits enemies
[*] Fish item will no longer appear if you have 2 losses
[*] Microscope moved from turn 9 to turn 7
[*] Devil and Brumpor's abilities now stack with multiple of each
[*] Sap/milk now scale with the amount of Moos/Frumptuns you have
[*] Tears no longer mutate into bubble goo
[*] Speed tiebreakers are now in place. Enemies got a lot of the random tiebreakers before, now if speed it tied its highest hp -> Highest attack -> highest defense

notes.title: Update 1.6! Goo Gangs, Custom Icons and more!
notes.notes:
Huge update this week, Lets get into it.

[h1] Goo Gangs [/h1]
We have the first version of Goo Gangs out, Form a Gang and start upgrading your gang to be the best goo gang in the Galaxy with your friends! Gangs are a great way to see what your friends are up to and to start collecting wins as a group! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/65d84d7fa70b697982c4550aa972999f8080e5e5.png[/img]

[h1] Customizable Icons/Backgrounds [/h1]
You can now show off things you earn with your goolah beyond goo skins! We have added customizable Icons to your player. This way you can show off a little more personal flair 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/8c880a3d6d4cdfcb0b7d377390c79cd1814da0c7.png[/img]

[h1] Leaderboard and stats [/h1]
Some more of the stats have brought to light! You can now go to the new stats page to see how many wins you have gotten, how many goos you have mutated and more! On top of that you can now see how well you stack up against the world with the global leaderboard of goos. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706528/3dc4170fd84f89ee0171734c739c8dbf3df2c7d8.png[/img]

[h1] Balance updates [/h1]
A bit of smaller balance update this week compared to last week. We have given some goos that had lower usage rates since the last update some more reason to check them out! The burning goo/flirx, even after being buffed last week, still seemed very weak for how late you could get them. Gramma could be gotten a full turn before Flirx and had better stats. This is no longer the case as we increased the time to get Gramma and reduced the time it takes to get a Flirx, on top of that they got a pretty strong stats buff across the board. The hammer seemed to hardly ever be used so we gave it a 3x buff in attack bonuses. That should allow some good combos with Mooshy/Snaim. The Bubble Goo has been reworked a bit, we gave it more starting HP and reduced its speed. This should allow you to put it more towards the front and take a hit before it pops. Lastly some of the later game goos such as the Meow, Brumopor and devil all felt like they were underpowered for what you had to give up to get them that late in the game, they all have been given pretty good buffs. 

[h1] Final Thoughts [/h1]
I'm super excited for the full launch next week! It has been a blast seeing you guys play this game so far in its pre-release state. We have tons of in game events and more things to come, this is just the start. As always thank you so much for your support please let me know if you have any questions or feedback.

notes.title: Update 1.4 First beta changes!
notes.notes:
The beta has been a blast so far! I've loved being able to see everyone get to play around with the Goos and the teams that you guys have made. We have fixed a ton of bugs as well as changed some of the game balance. Lets walk through some of that. Feel free to skip down to the bottom if you just want to see the raw changes :)

[h1] Balance reasoning [/h1]
The first thing I wanted to address was the early game was kind of boring. It was just rock vs rock in the first 2/3 turns. The seed bag has been moved up to a turn 0 item. This also will make it easier to change the seed into Frumptun as he can start growing a couple turns sooner. As well the Spray bottle will now come after the first turn, This means that on turn 2 there are 5 different goos that you can start to build your strategy around (Default, Rock, Flower, Seed, Moss).

The next major thing I wanted to address was goos that felt 'too strong' or 'too weak' Frumptun was the least used goo in the last update, by far, so they are getting a pretty good buff with some extra health and their item they drop now giving +4/+4 instead of +3/+3 Being able to get them sooner will also hopefully increase their usage. Mooshy and Brumpor had very high win rates in late rounds, Both of them have been given slight nerfs in the form of their item not applying before their mutation. This reduces the brumpors speed by -1 and the mushs starting attack by 5. As well the mushroom summons have been nerfed. The idea of the mushroom summons was to be 'cannon fodder' and not something that can take a hit and then also do some damage. They are now slower, lower attack, no longer have shields and have a bit more HP.

The last major balance thing you will notice is that round 1 is no longer a 'free win'. The free win was stopping the bubble goo and crybaby goo from being able to be unlocked (You need to lose your first three matches to get the crybaby) As the bubble and crybaby were not in the last meta I'm very curious to see how the integrate! 

[h1] Closing Thoughts [/h1]
Thank you guys so much for participating in the beta so far! Tons of more fixes and improvements are in the works! Look forward to Goo Gangs, more bug fixes and more balance coming next Wednesday.
As always, Let me know if you have any questions or comments.
